{{Quote|We're clenching our fists tighter around the Rebel Alliance. Soon they won't be in existence. They're nothing but trouble. You should stay away from them.|TK-471 boasting to an unidentified [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''TK-471''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]].

==Biography==
He was stationed in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] Imperial capital of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. He was an apparent supporter of [[Victor Visalis]], and his "Stormtrooper surge" policy.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TK-471 appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
